messages:
Alex M.: FYI — spotted a revenue drift in yesterday's daily report (~£7k). Looks like the nightly Stripe->NetSuite reconciler created duplicate NetSuite invoices for users in the pricing experiment (promo_v2). Repro/logs below, please take a look.

Alex M.: ```json
// webhook received
{
  \"id\": \"evt_1KxExample\", 
  \"type\": \"invoice.created\", 
  \"data\": {\"object\":{\"id\":\"in_1KxInvoice\",\"customer\":\"cus_Jy123\",\"lines\":[...],\"metadata\":{\"experiment\":\"promo_v2\"}}}
}

// netsuite create call 1
POST /netsuite/invoices
payload: {external_ref: \"stripe:in_1KxInvoice\", amount: 1450, memo: \"promo_v2 override\"}
response: 201 id=NSINV-98765

// netsuite create call 2 (one second later)
POST /netsuite/invoices
payload: {external_ref: \"stripe:in_1KxInvoice-overrideGuid123\", amount: 1450, memo: \"promo_v2.override\"}
response: 201 id=NSINV-98766
```

Priya K.: Do we dedupe by external_ref? The second payload appended an \"-overrideGuid123\" — why is reconciler adding that?

Matt G.: Looking at reconciler code: it builds external_ref = f\"stripe:{invoice.id}{'-'+price_override_id if override else ''}\". price_override_id is a transient render GUID from the pricing pipeline. That means the same Stripe invoice can produce multiple external_ref values -> duplicates. That's the bug.

Alex M.: Confirmed in reconciler.log:
```
[2026-03-01T02:12:33Z] INFO create_invoice external_ref=stripe:in_1KxInvoice status=201 ns_id=NSINV-98765
[2026-03-01T02:12:34Z] INFO create_invoice external_ref=stripe:in_1KxInvoice-overrideGuid123 status=201 ns_id=NSINV-98766
```
The reconciler does a GET by external_ref before create, so with different keys it doesn't detect the duplicate.

Priya K.: We need a hotfix. Accounting will want the duplicate voided and an audit note. @Lena A. can you confirm we can void NSINV-98766 and what info you need?

Lena A.: We can void the duplicate but need: 1) reason text in NS (e.g., \"automated duplication from reconciler\"), 2) the two NS invoice IDs, 3) link to PR/hotfix ticket. Please open an ACCT ticket and add me.

Matt G.: I'll open a PR to change dedupe key to just stripe.invoice.id and add an idempotency check that queries NetSuite by external_ref=stripe:{invoice.id} only. Also adding a migration: backfill to detect stripe invoice ids with >1 NS invoice and mark the later ones as duplicates (with reason). PR: https://git.redwood/infra/reconciler/pull/234

billing-bot: Created ticket ACCT-2026: Duplicate invoice reversal requested by Alex M.

Alex M.: Another issue: our daily_revenue_aggregate job counts NetSuite invoices by posting_date, so these duplicates were double-counted. We should run the backfill and then re-run the aggregate job for 2026-03-01 before closing this. I'll prepare a backfill script that flags duplicates and emits CSV for accounting.

Matt G.: Deploying fix to staging now (will include unit test + integration check). After review I'll deploy to prod in the 02:00-05:00 UTC window tonight. I'll run the backfill in staging and re-run the revenue job to validate. ETA ~3h.

Priya K.: Please include steps for rollback and add a quick postmortem once done. @all — any blockers from ops or accounting?

Lena A.: No blockers. Once ACCT-2026 has the note and the void is performed, we can reclose the books for that day. Please CC me on the PR.

Matt G.: Note: added extra guard to reconciler to reject external_ref suffixes created from transient GUIDs. Will also add a monitoring alert if reconciler creates >1 NS invoice for same stripe.invoice.id within 24h.

Alex M.: Thanks. I'll coordinate with finance ops to re-run the revenue aggregate after you finish. :thumbsup:

Priya K.: Adding to weekly sync agenda. Thanks everyone. :pray:
